cases.when: 从真实公开执行入口，先配对比较Brave/Tavily结果规整并作为带来源编号的短context交给模型，再在固定证据集上比较逐题顺序、逐题并发、每批3/5/10题和单批30题；通过临时StockWiki公开导入/ACK路径验收隔离结果。
then: 运行前manifest锁定样本、精确30题、release/rubric hash、gold与盲评抽样seed、模型/搜索参数、方法顺序、硬预算和明确质量阈值；实际请求与失败attempt逐项对账，不因结果删样本。
Brave/Tavily结果规整为短的不可信context并带稳定source_id；run专属临时工件中的snippet快照（G3审查后清理）必须与实际发送内容完全一致，单条最多500字符/每公司最多30,000字符；原始response、完整网页/财报和公司文档不落盘。
每个打包方案严格覆盖30个唯一question_id并返回独立status/score-or-unknown/evidence_refs/rationale；缺失、重复、错题、schema错误均独立报告且不得作为有效正式评分。匹配组不得混用模型答案。

解盲前由两名独立评审者基于冻结rubric/来源建立gold并记录分歧裁决。方案质量门槛为：唯一题目ID/schema覆盖100%；gold可评分题有效分覆盖至少95%，gold unknown不得强填；抽样非关键事实source support至少90%；critical claims逐条复核且无未解决重大错误；与裁决gold相比MAE≤0.75且至少90%在±1内；相对逐题顺序基线，MAE最多差0.25、source support最多低5个百分点、可评分覆盖最多低5个百分点。非关键claim按每个公司×方法至少max(10题、每入选模块2题)分层抽样，跨三家公司每方法至少30条，少于30则inconclusive。未达到gold/抽样复核条件记inconclusive，不进入胜出集。
报告每个公司×方法的端到端总耗时和阶段耗时；三家公司单轮仅报原始值/中位数/范围，不报run级p90或显著性。至少20个同口径完整run才报run级p50/p90；单请求分位数注明请求数且不代替全run耗时。
分别报告搜索API实际账单/credits、模型实际usage/缓存token、失败/重试的计费、每家公司30题总现金费用与每个有效答案费用；附执行日官方价格快照。MiniMax报告套餐窗口quota变化/拒绝和额外现金费用，不推造单位价格。
搜索缓存、provider前缀缓存、应用答案缓存分别在正交子实验中取得实际hit/miss证据：搜索和前缀子实验绕过答案缓存；全链warm复用为零新增搜索/模型派发；query/filter变更使搜索缓存miss，材料性答案hash变更仅使受影响题失效。无usage证据的provider缓存按保守未命中成本报告。

assertions.expected: All six declared request strategies are reconciled against exact IDs; failed and malformed attempts stay visible; no mixed-model matched arm.

assertions.expected: Use independent cache namespaces and orthogonal subruns: bypass answer cache when measuring real search/prefix cache, prove same-input end-to-end warm reuse, and prove query/filter and material answer-hash invalidation.

assertions.expected: Two independent reviewers create/adjudicate gold before unblinding; enforce score MAE <=0.75 and <=0.25 worse than per-question baseline, >=90% within +/-1, support >=90% and <=5pp below baseline, >=95% eligible coverage and <=5pp below baseline; sample >=max(10 questions,2/module/company-method) and >=30 factual claims/method or inconclusive.
Record raw company-run total/stage timing; report run-level p50/p90 only with >=20 matched complete runs; otherwise provide raw values/median/range and request counts.

assertions.entrypoint: Temporary StockWiki public import/ACK and isolated-workspace cleanup audit
assertions.expected: No production state drift or company document download; only exact manifest-owned temporary files are removed, otherwise evidence is retained safely.
Any combined search+packing recommendation includes the predeclared 2x2 crossover; otherwise conclusions are conditional. Pareto eligibility first requires fixed accuracy gates.

cases.given: 200家公司，预算与运行范围冻结，注入至少一次中断并恢复。

cases.when: 执行扩容与维护报告。
then: 报告实体/证券/市场重叠及各字段有效/尝试/待办；只对已经通过的评分/事实能力宣告交付。

置信度和公司分数分列；信息日期与入库时间分别显示。

then: 任意时点全局在途≤4、各组≤2、各路由≤1，且独立问题存在发送时间重叠，不能用串行冒充并发。

then: 持久化A组冷却至提供商reset_at，并通知其他worker；未派发请求按顺序跳过两个A路由，仅尝试B。
A已发请求仍接受回执/记账；普通429不编造五小时剩余额度或reset_at，按短期限流策略处理。

cases.when: 下一primary逻辑题到达，A只有并发槽满，没有故障或额度拒绝。
then: 等待A空槽；B发送计数为0，不能为了吞吐擅改用户优先级，也不能同一primary题向A/B抢答。
A完成后派发待办并记录A；显式comparison必须另有比较组和预算，不能混用此逻辑题键。

新包ID不产生6个新逻辑题；保留每个attempt/pack/prompt hash，混合模型的公司快照逐字段显示来源。

cases.given: 两个worker/两个run同时收到同一公司、刷新代次、字段和题义的primary待办；随后重复点击start。

cases.given: A的POST已发但只得HTTP 500/超时；另有明确提供商配额拒绝及可信未执行回执。
cases.when: 分类尝试并决定是否使用B。
then: 500/超时保持uncertain并先对账、不立即再POST；明确未执行拒绝可按用户顺序fallback，全部尝试计预算并保留脱敏回执。

cases.given: 双挂牌同一ENT公司，身份revision 1的旧work未决；核实后revision 2更换来源绑定且新增证券成员。
cases.when: 通过StockWiki权威身份/成员事务与StockQA待办接续。
then: 实体题在同一身份revision内只问一次，证券题分开；旧work/观察仍绑revision 1，revision 2建新代次并先对账未决请求。

cases.given: 2,000家长批次中300家已答、7个send_intent未确认、其余待办；期间发布新recipe。
cases.when: 停机、恢复旧run并逐步启用新run。
then: 已答不重问，7个不明先对账；旧run依原recipe推进，新策略只建受影响缺口；成员/费用/待办计数守恒。

cases.given: 客户端只支持Query v1；服务端具v2时间/模型/词表投影，另有缺失某能力的实例。
cases.when: 协商schema_version/capabilities并请求新字段。
then: 旧v1在兼容窗只读可用，新字段缺能力返回unavailable及原因，不返回空集合或猜测值；分页持同一snapshot/watermark。

cases.given: 同公司两个时间点、两个模型、两套评分尺和一条不可比题，2000家分页；桌面与窄屏浏览器。
cases.when: 通过真实StockWiki UI切换模块/lens/时间/模型。
then: 页面展示原答时间、实际模型、来源、版本、可比差和不可比原因；分页稳定，键盘可达且浏览模型调用0。

cases.given: 安装配套表声称版本一致但实际加载某旧题包/旧StockQA能力hash；另有旧版归档与费用账本。
cases.when: 独立审查版本握手和混搭回退证据。
then: 基于真实加载hash/兼容矩阵阻止新写，旧观察只读；审查报告逐项列源码、测试、迁移与费用回执，不把版本名当证据。

cases.given: X10已有明确live授权、有限题/费用预算和隔离清理器；真实A/H双挂牌及一美股小样本。
cases.when: 从统一入口跑搜索、评分、事实、lens与查询UI全链，并在中断点恢复。
then: 实际搜索/模型/费用/身份/recipe/词表/评分尺/时间回执齐全；重复运行不重问已答，三维比较不混口径。
临时SQLite/缓存/下载/日志逐文件登记并清理；外部仓、正式库、用户配置和非测试进程前后零漂移，否则live gate失败。

cases.given: 2,000家已保存原答；只新增别名、筛选lens和一个仅5家适用的事实问题。
cases.when: 重建索引/名单并生成增量待办。
then: 原答hash、费用、信息日期保持不变；词表/lens升级模型调用0，仅5家新增事实字段待办，不全池重扫。

cases.given: 真实StockWiki库的只读备份副本与旧版本投影存在；迁移在提交/切换前故障。
cases.when: 在临时SQLite演练升级、恢复和回滚。
then: 旧库/观察/成员/费用/outbox可读且hash不变；失败停新写并保留证据，不删除数据库或重置已付费工作。

cases.given: 主题/行业技能请求不存在的taxonomy版本或只有旧Query capability；库中另有未核实同词关系。
cases.when: 经真实消费者入口查询并定向补缺。
then: 明确返回unsupported/unavailable及候选/缺口，不把空结果说成产业链无人；不直接写库，不为少数公司启动全池扫描。

cases.given: 冻结61题事实包及新本体release；同一设备词分别出现在制造、使用、供应和客户关系中。
cases.when: 用本仓真实schema/发布器编译关系ID、方向、角色、阶段、时期与分部。
then: 每条关系有唯一稳定ID与冻结语义hash；旧事实题ID/原词/事实包字节不变，变更别名不改变关系方向。

cases.given: 发布候选试图把uses_equipment等同makes_equipment，或缺角色/时期/分部作用层，另有未知本体版本。
cases.when: 由本仓本体发布校验器验签并解析。
then: 不安全crosswalk和缺必需方向信息均被拒绝；旧版按可信归档只读，未知新版不得降级按旧语义写入。

cases.given: 固定UTC时钟、一个评分风险字段到期、另一个字段fresh；同字段同时收到人工强制和重大事件。
cases.when: 调用本仓刷新策略纯解析器两次。
then: 只输出受影响字段及稳定的reason/next_generation/策略hash；事件、强制和TTL按固定优先级归并，同原因幂等。

cases.given: 旧观察只有imported_at较新而information_as_of未知；另新增无关模块、词表别名及筛选阈值。
cases.when: 本仓刷新策略解析旧观察和新策略。
then: 未知信息日期不能变fresh；词表/阈值/无关模块不产旧题新generation，旧valid_until与策略版本不被回写。

cases.given: 能力配置A只支持普通文本，B声明web_search但缺可验证回执格式，用户顺序A→B。
cases.when: 调用StockQA提供商能力适配器的纯预检入口。
then: 两者都不满足需要可验证搜索的题，返回逐模型原因与能力版本；不创建请求、不读取密钥、不把模型自报视为能力。

cases.given: HTTP 200回答带两个网址和‘已搜索’，真实工具事件为空；另一事件URL属于相邻request/call。
cases.when: 调用StockQA搜索回执适配器解析固定厂商响应。
then: 状态为unverified、跨call网址拒绝归属；旧无call-id的历史结果可读但不补签为executed。

cases.given: 一次HTTP 500、一次超时、一次带厂商明确未执行码与回执的429拒绝。
cases.when: 调用StockQA能力/拒绝分类适配器。
then: 500/超时归执行结果不明并保留已知运输回执，429仅在可信未执行证据齐备时归明确拒绝；不在适配器内自行重发POST。

cases.given: 冻结recipe引用缺失题包、mandatory风险题超预算或StockQA没有等价web_search能力。
cases.when: 通过V09的真实公开派发/work/预算入口尝试运行。
then: HTTP POST、持久WorkItem和费用预留新增均为0；返回与EVO-02纯解析器一致的明确原因，不静默删题或降级能力。

cases.given: 真实F06事实发布包与F03词表release均匹配；已有可信scoring_only旧recipe/24核心观察。
cases.when: 调用本仓事实版ScanRecipe解析器。
then: facts_enabled recipe只新增适用事实字段及独立事实预算，旧scoring_only字节/hash/核心分/已答work键不变；事实答数值score不得进入规范输出。

cases.given: 事实包与路由锁、关系本体或词表release不相容，或分部事实缺segment_id；旧评分版仍有效。
cases.when: 调用本仓fact-mode解析/历史读取。
then: 新事实派发在模型请求前拒绝并报告精确冲突；旧scoring_only仍可读/可继续，不回填伪事实包。

cases.given: 评分run已有24核心有效观察；事实版只新增3条适用字段，用户模型顺序与费用上限已冻结。
cases.when: 经StockQA真实公开runner/work/预算/outbox的同一事实执行入口运行。
then: 3条事实工作共享原执行/预算/回执链，评分旧题POST数0；事实数值score拒绝、合法事实内部score=null，各记录绑recipe_id/hash。

cases.given: 事实版一个POST已提交send_intent后超时，另一个事实结果已持久但StockWiki ACK丢失。
cases.when: 停止、重启并接续StockQA事实运行。
then: 不明请求先对账不换模型重发，已答只重投递不重问；费用和attempt不重置，评分版待办不受影响。

cases.given: 真实旧格式run/work/observation早于ScanRecipe，原执行/身份/题义证据有的齐全、有的缺失。
cases.when: 经V01历史读取与新派发预检入口解析。
then: 旧记录标legacy_without_recipe且不伪造recipe_id；可证明兼容者只读复用，证据不足者needs_review并禁止自动付费重问。

cases.given: StockWiki临时数据库副本中存在旧identity revision、无recipe观察和未决attempt/费用行。
cases.when: 仅运行V09/V10拥有者的迁移/适配器，不启动统一X05入口、不调用provider。
then: 无recipe历史仅按可证明证据只读适配；迁移前后回答hash/费用/outbox数量守恒；无法核实的旧行标needs_review；不生成新generation/work/费用预留，POST为0。

cases.given: StockQA独立临时旧账本包含已答、未决send_intent、费用与outbox，均无recipe_id；StockWiki不参与该用例。
cases.when: 只调用V09兼容runner和派发预检，并模拟重启。
then: 旧已答只读，未决请求先对账，证据不足needs_review且零自动POST；新work才绑定当前recipe，旧attempt/费用/回执不改。

cases.given: 已有24条有效评分观察；新启用3个适用事实字段且库内尚无这些字段的有效观察，其中两挂牌为同一实体、一个事实关系作用于证券；V13/V14不可变recipe/回执齐全。
cases.when: 经StockWiki真实缺口、F04/W05导入、查询入口运行事实增量。
then: 只建3条适用事实work并按实体/证券作用层归属；事实观察有实际模型、时间、搜索、版本、recipe/hash且score=null；评分旧题POST数0，ACK后消费者可查同一snapshot。

cases.given: 事实观察已提交StockWiki但ACK丢失，随后recipe或身份revision冲突；另有旧scoring_only和pre-recipe观察。
cases.when: 重启后重投递同一V14 outbox并尝试导入冲突回执。
then: 同一事实观察不重复写也不重问，冲突停写待审；旧原答ID/hash、费用与原有名单不变，未核实关系不进入主题索引。

cases.given: 一个由唯一owner发布、具有schema/hash/能力/兼容范围的candidate组件release。
cases.when: 使用公共release envelope校验并生成不可变release lock。
then: release ID、内容hash、owner与组件专属schema全部被锁定；同一recipe仅引用该已登记release，不执行任意插件代码。

cases.given: 已发布release ID/hash已进入观察或recipe；有人以相同ID替换题义、兼容范围或能力。
cases.when: 重新校验该组件或加载历史recipe。
then: 拒绝同ID内容变化并报告hash冲突；旧观察仍按原包读取，新内容必须用新release ID，不自动转active。

cases.given: 本项目真实归档的问题模块发布包早于公共component envelope；历史观察仍引用该包，且另有deprecated/retired release。
cases.when: 使用归档版本专属reader读取历史包，并分别检查当前候选发布/新recipe是否可用。
then: 历史包仅在归档hash与旧schema可核实时按legacy_read_only解释；缺少可验证证据时needs_review。deprecated仅在兼容窗内可用，retired禁止新组合/派发；任何情况都不删除旧观察。

cases.given: producer schema或能力高于consumer声明支持范围，兼容校验器只收到release envelope元数据。
cases.when: 调用公共兼容判定器，分别请求历史读取、新写入和付费派发能力结果。
then: 分别返回legacy_read_only、adapter_required或blocked等精确动作状态和原因；兼容声明按producer/consumer精确release及动作查找，并遵守EVO-83的UTC半开时间窗。纯校验器不发HTTP、不写数据库、不把未知映射成分数，真实入口阻断由StockWiki W16/X05/X09验证。

cases.given: V10公开快照显示公司既有通用/行业问题均有效，V16/V17收到的新成长模块只增加一个缺失字段。
cases.when: V17计算release变化影响集合并生成续扫计划。
then: 计划仅将新增问题字段标selected_field_rescan；旧答案、信息时间、实际模型、generation和费用账本不变；本卡不写入/派发。

cases.given: 同一冻结答案快照和旧派生结果，发布差异只改变评分权重、lens阈值、词表别名或展示列。
cases.when: V17比较release依赖图并形成影响plan。
then: 只输出对应projection_rebuild及依赖范围；LLM/HTTP POST为0、观察和待办不变；实际派生视图重建由owner消费者卡验收。

cases.given: V10真实只读快照中，路由/身份/题义release只影响明确Entity/字段，另有一个已派发旧recipe的work。
cases.when: V17经V10读取并生成影响plan，然后只读模拟下游对plan的校验。
then: plan只列可证明受影响的Entity/字段并保留旧work原recipe；V17不创建generation、不改状态、不发送请求，未受影响对象保持no_op。

cases.given: 同一快照含一条经V01可证明的legacy_without_recipe旧答，以及另一条缺少身份revision/依赖边而无法验证的旧答。
cases.when: 运行V17版本影响分析。
then: 可验证旧答仍只读可复用并返回no_op/适配器结论；证据不足对象单独needs_review/blocked且调用为0，不把全部旧记录一概拦截，也不触发全池重扫。

cases.given: 旧版已持久化有限答案、短依据、citation URL、attempt/request/response ID、completed search call ID/status及URL-call归属；原始HTTP/web_search正文未保存。
cases.when: 使用新解析/标准化release读取并重放该问答。
then: 只有最小搜索回执和保存答案足以验证搜索资格/语义时才生成新的派生规范化版本；原answer/observation hash、旧解释和费用不变，模型请求与文件下载均为0。

cases.given: 旧短答案缺少新解析规则要求的来源-call归属或数值期间，且无完整原始响应可回看。
cases.when: 新解析器尝试重标准化和产生正式分数。
then: 保持unknown或needs_review，不补造来源/期间/分数；不得认定搜索合格、访问网络、重问模型或将默认5写入评分。

cases.given: 一个批次中的不同问题因顺位fallback使用不同真实provider/model和不同解析器release。
cases.when: 生成逐题回执与可比较结果。
then: 每题保留实际provider/model、解析和答案schema版本、attempt/response ID及search call/source归属；若批次级字段不能无损表示混用则标null/heterogeneous，不能继承首选模型标签或将版本差异说成经营变化。

cases.given: 旧发布集含scoring_only和legacy_without_recipe历史，新发布集增加解析版本与一个事实关系词表扩展但保留评分题义。
cases.when: 在隔离临时库执行升级读取与影响计划。
then: 旧评分历史按旧release只读可见，解析/词表变化只处理证据足够的派生投影和新增字段；旧题零重问、recipe和身份不被补签或改写。

cases.given: 临时SQLite升级在复制新release锁后、切换active前发生进程中断。
cases.when: 重启并检查旧/新release、观察、待办、outbox及费用水位。
then: 失败升级保持旧release可读和active；未提交变更回滚到本run临时副本，已发生费用/POST意图不消失，不触发补偿性付费请求。

cases.given: 新release已局部激活但消费者加载hash或数据库migration版本不符，随后请求回退。
cases.when: 经公开升级入口执行受控回退和重放。
then: 停新写/新派发，原始答案、观察、费用和未决请求保持守恒；回到上一兼容release或明确read-only/needs_review，不反向覆盖历史。

cases.given: 冻结样本包含一家处于行业周期低谷但仍有品牌/渠道/成本优势、资金尚可且有可验证恢复条件的公司。
cases.when: 只升级无关行业模块、provider能力元数据或lens展示版本，并沿时间/模型维度回放。
then: 未受影响的持久优势证据、低谷评分、恢复观察资格和旧模型结果均保留；版本变化单列，不能把低分自动清池或误报基本面恶化。

cases.given: V16—V18/Q14已完成实现、固定样本、升级/回退记录与当前测试结果。
cases.when: 独立审查者按组件、时间、模型、身份、答案解析、费用及迁移维度逐项复核。
then: 核对版本/快照hash、决策边界、公开数据溯源、存储成本、迁移、盲点与回滚；报告问题严重度和大节点放行结论。

cases.given: 当前StockWiki权威快照与有效V16/V17计划一致，动作是新增一个尚缺的行业/成长问题字段。
cases.when: 经StockWiki公开缺口/续扫入口应用该plan。
then: 单一事务仅新增目标Entity/字段generation/work，旧字段答案、信息时间、模型与费用不变；重放同一plan不重复创建。

cases.given: 同一公司观察只因lens阈值、评分权重、词表别名或展示投影release变化产生projection_rebuild。
cases.when: StockWiki通过唯一owner投影入口处理该动作。
then: 只更派生视图并保留旧snapshot可读；新增paid work、generation和LLM调用均为0。

cases.given: V17 plan hash已过期，或身份revision/当前字段generation与plan不符。
cases.when: StockWiki公开写入口尝试应用plan。
then: 事务前拒绝并返回stale_plan/identity_conflict；数据库行、outbox和模型/HTTP POST计数均不变，不猜测性套用。

cases.given: 真实临时SQLite在创建字段work与记录plan应用水位之间注入崩溃。
cases.when: 重启并重放同一V17 plan。
then: 事务全回滚或完整提交且幂等恢复；不出现孤儿work/重复generation，不改旧观察/费用/已发送请求；清理仅限本次run登记文件。

cases.given: StockWiki W16 owner API/CLI收到一个V16 lock与V17 plan已核实、仅新增单字段的受控请求，并准备为新work签发绑定精确attempt/recipe/active pointer的派发授权。
cases.when: 在独立临时SQLite中直接调用W16公开新增/续扫入口并请求该work的一次性dispatch fence。
then: owner路径消费同一确定性重算plan，只创建目标新字段generation/work；既有题零重问，字段generation/recipe hash和费用回执可追溯；仅对当前active资格与精确attempt签发短时、单次permit，记录完整绑定字段且重复领取不能签发第二个permit；不访问其他公司或下载文档。X05调用此接口的集成另由后置X09场景验收。

cases.given: A verified temporary router 2.3 package (policy schema 1.3, request protocol 3) with ROUTE_02 native responses at scores 6, 7, and 10, an unscored response, a StockQA quick_scan_result/1.0.0 public envelope with answer-hash-bound execution receipt, low per-module evidence, independent verified_facts, one archived router 2.0 snapshot, and synthesized router 2.1/2.2 compatibility-path snapshots.
cases.when: Parse the native response, resolve the route, seal/read snapshots, and invoke current execution/composition gates.
then: The classification score is preserved separately from company-quality scores. Below the frozen threshold only searched_llm candidates become uncertain; independently verified facts remain eligible. At/above threshold, per-module evidence rules still apply. Snapshot validation recomputes internal confidence, receipt, module and dispatch invariants. Its self-computed content hash does not authenticate source provenance; a new execution must compare against the caller's independently stored decision ID. The actual archived router 2.0 fixture remains readable; generated router 2.1 compatibility paths remain read-only, without claiming coverage from a preserved historical 2.1 artifact.

assertions.expected: Native status and integer score are returned in the normalized classification_confidence envelope; unscored statuses retain null, with no placeholder/default score. The public StockQA result adapter accepts only the documented v1 envelope and verifies exact entity/question identity, completed web-search receipt, actual/requested model, candidate source membership, and SHA-256 of the serialized ROUTE_02 answer. resolve_route_decision receives one complete raw answer and derives the candidate, confidence, and answer hash from that same value; split caller-supplied fields are not accepted.
A score below 7 marks applicable searched_llm module candidates uncertain with overall_confidence_below_threshold and excludes them from selected/eligible modules.
At score 7 the overall gate permits evaluation but does not bypass a module rule; a low per-module confidence or inapplicable evidence remains uncertain/rejected.
At score 10, a low-confidence searched_llm candidate remains uncertain; overall confidence never overrides individual evidence/materiality/confirmation gates.
A separately supplied valid verified_fact remains selected on a low overall model score and can retain mandatory recovery coverage.

Tampered status/score/threshold/eligibility, mismatched execution confidence, or a selected below-threshold searched_llm candidate is rejected after resealing. A resealed source-label rewrite is rejected at execution when its decision ID differs from the caller's independently stored expected ID; the self-computed snapshot hash alone is not provenance authentication. Changing the StockQA answer while retaining its receipt answer_sha256, or pairing answer A with answer B's separate receipt, is rejected before a route can be composed; split caller-supplied candidate/confidence/hash fields are rejected.
Unknown/insufficient_evidence require score=null and an empty candidate list; a no-call route is explicitly not_run/null; inconsistent candidate/status/receipt combinations fail closed.

The preserved router 2.0 snapshot remains readable under its archived package. Generated router 2.1 compatibility-path snapshots are readable but cannot dispatch; this is not evidence from a preserved historical router 2.1 artifact. Current resolve/execute/compose paths refuse historical routers.

Schema 1.3/request-protocol-3 confidence policy with router version 2.3.0 or later, a bounded integer threshold, and the supported downgrade action publishes; malformed or mismatched policy versions are rejected. Its schema also rejects scored-with-null/out-of-range score and unknown/insufficient_evidence-with-non-null score combinations. Router 2.2 remains bound to schema 1.2/request-protocol-2. Explicit router 2.0, 2.1, and 2.2 historical readers retain only their documented compatibility behavior and cannot dispatch current work.

then: 真实本地producer链输出符合契约且可追溯到固定renderer/module版本；网络、密钥和财报下载均未触发，临时数据库/文件/进程副作用全数回收。该case仅证明本仓离线链，不宣称真实搜索、StockWiki导入/ACK、UI或安装启动已验收。

assertions.entrypoint: isolated local producer end-to-end CLI workflow
assertions.expected: Question compose and standard observation build invoke real local public entrypoints; exchange schema/content hashes pass; subprocesses receive no API keys/live opt-in, network is denied, download path stays empty, and exact temporary root is cleaned after success and failure.

cases.given: question_library、question_sets兼容入口与standard_answers的导入图和已固定的S07提示契约。
cases.when: 在无API密钥的全新子进程中按两种顺序导入组件，并检查稳定库模块依赖与答案构建器调用边。
then: json_io独占通用UTF-8 JSON实现；question_prompts与question_library复用它。question_library只依赖本地question module/schema和纯校验代码，不反向导入CLI、答案构建器、provider、网络或生产存储；standard_answers不再通过question_sets做题库加载、URL或profile操作。唯一保留的question_sets边是复杂的不可变manifest验证与历史question fingerprint，且必须静态可见。

assertions.entrypoint: question_library import graph and standard_answers module dependencies
assertions.expected: Both import orders succeed without credentials or live flags; question_library imports no higher-layer module; prompt/catalog layers import one json_io owner rather than redefining read_json; standard_answers has no question_sets dynamic import and its only allowed direct references are validate_manifest_metric_contract and _question_fingerprint.

cases.given: 本仓question catalog、scoring contexts、profile fixture、临时ROOT与当前已发布renderer/module release。
cases.when: 经question_library公开接口加载并校验题库/profile，同时经question_sets兼容入口和standard_answers真实接口读取同一内容。
then: source catalog、URL判定、profile拒绝规则、UTF-8 JSON语义及ROOT注入一致；question_sets旧函数签名继续可用。standard_answers的validate_fact_library/select_facts在临时备用ROOT中返回该根内的专属版本标记和问题，不回落仓库根目录；既有观察回放由producer E2E继续校验。

assertions.entrypoint: question_library APIs, question_sets compatibility facade and standard_answers public functions
assertions.expected: question_library and the question_sets compatibility facade return the same catalog/profile results for fixed valid and invalid inputs; standard_answers.validate_fact_library and select_facts consume a uniquely marked alternate-root fact bank, while isolated output paths remain under the registered temporary root.

cases.when: 用本仓真实本地CLI从question library/compose走到标准化观察与交换内容hash验证。
then: 答案构建器与题库CLI沿稳定下层契约完成producer离线链；未调用网络/模型、未读取或写入财报下载目录、未继承密钥/live opt-in，成功与失败路径均清理精确临时根。该用例不代表真实公司或StockWiki/UI跨仓验收。

assertions.entrypoint: isolated local producer end-to-end CLI workflow
assertions.expected: Real local public entrypoints produce and validate the fixture observation/exchange hashes with the same library release; network is denied, API key variables are absent, download path remains empty, and only the unique registered temporary root is removed.

cases.given: 本仓已发布问题包、固定profile、标准答案格式，以及semantic_fingerprint_version缺省时的旧算法和当前2.0.0规则；仓内没有真实归档1.x包。
cases.when: 分别经下层question_fingerprints契约和question_sets兼容包装计算题目指纹，并改变当前包的一项答案schema资源。
then: 旧格式缺省版本字段时的1.0.0算法指纹与冻结基准完全相同；当前2.0.0指纹绑定格式资源摘要；格式资源变化只改变新规则指纹；兼容包装输出与共享契约逐字节相同。

assertions.expected: The legacy-format projection with no semantic_fingerprint_version matches its frozen old-algorithm value; the v2 digest changes when a bound format resource changes. This does not claim replay of an authentic archived v1 package.
The legacy question_sets function signature delegates to exactly the same shared implementation and output.

cases.given: 当前已发布问题包和与其绑定的标准观察记录，以及answer builder的静态导入图。
cases.when: 通过standard_answers观察校验入口读取记录，并检查其question_sets调用面。
then: 有效发布包观察继续通过；伪造manifest仍在生成观察前拒绝；standard_answers只保留manifest语义验证这一条question_sets成员依赖。

assertions.expected: Current released answer semantics remain valid after fingerprint ownership moves below the CLI layer.
Manifest forgery continues to fail closed before observation construction.
AST inspection finds exactly validate_manifest_metric_contract among question_sets members referenced by standard_answers.

cases.given: 虚构entity/profile、固定本仓题库包和离线执行回执，运行于独占LiveE2ESandbox临时目录。
cases.when: 使用本仓公开compose、标准观察生成和交换hash验证入口完成完整producer流程。
then: 迁移后的指纹共享层可与题库编排和答案构建器共同完成离线端到端流程；网络/API/下载均未启用，测试结束仅清理由该次登记的临时根；结果不代表真实公司或外仓导入/ACK/UI验收。

assertions.expected: Real local public entrypoints produce and verify the fixture observation/exchange hashes with the same release; no network, secrets, model calls, or report downloads occur, and the unique sandbox is cleaned.

cases.given: S09已把题目指纹下沉，但standard_answers仍通过question_sets调用manifest校验，选择与screening renderer也仍处在编排模块。
cases.when: 把选择、manifest语义校验和screening renderer迁入独立owner模块，并从standard_answers直接消费稳定契约。
then: question_manifest和question_selection不导入question_sets；standard_answers不导入question_sets；question_sets旧校验/选择入口保留原签名；renderer hash与当前发布包逐字一致。

assertions.expected: Manifest and selection domain modules have no import edge back to the CLI orchestrator.
The existing one-argument question_sets validator wrapper remains callable and delegates to the versioned contract.
Moved prompt code preserves the source hash required by the active release.

cases.given: 当前不可变发布包、标准答案回执、兼容question_sets包装器及已知伪造manifest反例。
cases.when: 通过standard_answers构造发布观察，并分别输入有效清单与更换内容后重算顶层hash的伪造清单。
then: 有效发布观察保持可比；伪造manifest在观察生成前被拒绝；答案构建器直接使用question_manifest，而非question_sets成员。

assertions.expected: Valid current-release standard observations still validate and remain comparable across company identity.
Recomputed outer hashes cannot make a forged published manifest pass the immutable package validator.
The answer builder imports the lower question/manifest libraries and has no question_sets import.

assertions.expected: The local producer chain completes with stable release/hash lineage and cleans its exclusive sandbox without claiming a live search or StockWiki ACK.

cases.when: Apply an effective-dated issuer rename and listing ticker change.
then: The entity_id remains unchanged and is not derived from any name, market, ticker, or external provider key.
Name/ticker facts are appended with source and validity; identity_revision increments.
Every identity content change is an append-only event with from_revision/to_revision, source/evidence, and exactly one revision increment.

cases.when: Resolve candidate names and build the issuer relationship graph.
then: String similarity, shared brand/token, or an LLM suggestion cannot merge the candidates.
They remain separate or unresolved until authoritative identity evidence establishes alias, issuer, or group relation.

cases.when: Compare identifiers from different namespaces and a verified legal identifier.
then: Source-local IDs never identify an issuer outside their namespace.
Only a scheme registered for issuer scope and backed by trusted evidence may link issuers; conflicting claims fail closed.

cases.when: Represent securities and exchange listings under one verified issuer.
then: A/H share classes and ADR are separate Security records under one verified issuer.
Two venue listings of the same fungible security are distinct Listing records pointing to the same Security.
Issuer-level operating questions run once; valuation/quote scopes remain listing-specific.

cases.when: Persist non-unique name aliases and a uniqueness-constrained verified issuer claim in one transaction.
then: The same alias text can belong to multiple issuers with source/type/validity.
A claim uniqueness conflict is rejected atomically and leaves all previous claims unchanged.

given.input: name-only candidate with two similar issuer matches

cases.when: Import the candidate and prepare the scan queue.
then: Candidate remains unresolved without entity_id and no paid Work/Observation is created.
LLM output and citations can be reviewed but cannot activate identity or scan eligibility.

cases.when: Resolve exact and bare tickers, including a symbol reused after the first listing ends.
then: MIC/venue and effective time distinguish listings and ticker reuse.
A bare ticker with multiple valid candidates remains ambiguous; it cannot identify an issuer.

cases.when: Ingest source adapters and attempt cross-provider identity resolution.
then: Dayu ticker-derived IDs and StockInfo/CNINFO orgId are stored as source-scoped claims only.
The adapters do not merge issuers without an independently verified issuer bridge.

cases.when: Apply documented issuer rename and exchange-qualified ticker update.
then: Internal issuer/security/listing IDs stay stable when legal continuity is proven.
Identity revision and alias/listing history advance; old Work remains bound to its dispatch revision.

cases.when: Run eligibility preflight and scan scheduling.
then: The member and pin remain preserved for review.
No new paid Work is scheduled while identity is conflicted; conflict is visible with reason.

cases.when: Apply an audited issuer merge or split and render current and historical views.
then: Old observations retain original entity/listing IDs, model, timestamps, scores, and payload hashes.
The successor identity starts new generations and receives no inherited current score.

cases.when: Build logical work keys for issuer-level and listing-level questions.
then: Every work item binds entity_id and identity_revision.
Listing-scoped work binds security_id and listing_id so separate venues cannot collide; issuer questions remain deduplicated.

cases.when: Exchange and query the issuer profile and its quote scopes.
then: Responses preserve issuer, security, listing, identity_revision, and eligibility boundaries.
Consumers can deduplicate issuer questions without collapsing distinct market quotes.

cases.when: Create persistent work for the same issuer across multiple listing venues.
then: One logical business-question work item is created for the issuer.
Valuation work remains distinct per listing and idempotent by identity revision and listing scope.

cases.when: Create a company-level business-question run.
then: A stable analysis_subject_id/revision identifies the reported business perimeter independently of the legal issuer ID.
A/H/ADR quote scopes remain security/listing-bound; issuer group relations alone do not define consolidation membership.

cases.when: Create an analysis subject from an unresolved source listing.
then: The provisional subject is anchored to exactly that listing and issuer.
It cannot include subsidiaries, claim a consolidated reporting perimeter, or accept another listing without verified issuer evidence.

cases.when: Validate worldwide venue and ticker identity.
then: Valid ISO alpha-2 markets are not limited to CN/HK/US.
Overlapping same-market/ticker listings fail closed if either MIC is missing; two known distinct MICs remain distinct venues.

cases.when: Validate identity claims before they can enter candidate resolution.
then: Verified claims require non-empty evidence; invalid half-open intervals are rejected.
Aliases remain non-unique candidates and cannot by themselves authorize issuer linking.

cases.when: Validate identity revision events and historical source bindings.
then: Security/listing events must name the exact affected IDs and advance one revision; application must match the before/after snapshots.
A retired owner binding may preserve a delisted listing, while active listings require active bindings.

cases.when: A reporting perimeter changes and a new scan is dispatched.
then: New Work and Observation bind the new subject revision and exact issuer/security/listing scope.
Old observations preserve their original subject revision, model, timestamp, answer and score; legacy records are not silently assigned a subject.

cases.when: Validate a consolidated AnalysisSubject before creating company-level Work.
then: Verified issuer status, corporate-group relationships and evidence_ref text do not prove consolidated membership.
The owner-supplied verified receipt must bind the exact subject ID/revision, primary issuer, membership roles/effective intervals and perimeter snapshot digest to an HTTPS disclosure source.
complete_as_disclosed is accepted only when that exact perimeter snapshot is covered by the trusted receipt.

cases.when: Apply an identity or AnalysisSubject event to immutable before/after snapshots.
then: Ticker/listing events must name the exact Security referenced by the affected Listing and exact changed listing/security IDs.
AnalysisSubject events bind subject ID and consecutive revisions, encode old/new values or perimeter hashes, and list exactly the affected issuer IDs.
Wrong, missing, extra, no-op or snapshot-inconsistent event targets are rejected before any owner transaction.

cases.when: Validate a worldwide issuer listing against its trusted venue registry.
then: Market membership is checked against the trusted ISO jurisdiction registry; a two-letter lexical shape alone is insufficient.
A supplied MIC must belong to the declared market in the trusted registry; unknown registries or mismatched MICs fail closed.
Overlapping same-market ticker listings still require known, distinct MICs to remain separate venues.

cases.when: Invoke the public identity contract CLI as a subprocess for each supported identity object type.
then: A valid Entity 2.1.0 request returns exactly one JSON line with status valid and exit 0; the input file bytes remain unchanged.
A valid AnalysisSubject 1.0.0 request returns exactly one JSON line with status valid and exit 0; output explicitly represents contract validation only.

assertions.expected: Valid synthetic Entity 2.1.0 under package 2.2.0 is accepted by schema and semantic reference validators; one-line stdout, exit 0, unchanged input.
Valid synthetic AnalysisSubject 1.0.0 is accepted against provided context; one-line stdout includes contract-only scope, exit 0, unchanged input.

given.trusted_source_binding: references a different Security or Listing

cases.when: Invoke the public identity contract CLI on a reference-mismatched request.
then: Exit 2 with status invalid, stable semantic error code and a JSON Pointer under /payload; no payload value or sentinel is echoed to stdout or stderr.

assertions.expected: Wrong source-to-Security/Listing binding fails closed, exit 2, structured error only, no user-controlled value leakage.

cases.when: Invoke the CLI with an unsupported --schema-version.
then: Exit 3 with status invalid, error code unknown_schema_version and stable pointer /schema_version; the input path is not opened and one JSON line is emitted.

assertions.expected: Unsupported package versions fail before input I/O with stable machine-readable output and exit 3.

given.input_size: one byte over the published maximum

cases.when: Invoke the CLI on each hostile input using a temporary directory.
then: Duplicate keys and oversized inputs fail closed with stable structured error codes and exit 2; neither input is changed and no input content is echoed.

assertions.expected: Duplicate JSON object keys are rejected rather than last-key-wins; exit 2 and no content echo.
Input exceeds documented bounded maximum, is rejected with exit 2 without full read or mutation.
